steps.title: Enter Your Email
steps.description: No password needed. Just type your email address and click Continue. There are no lengthy registration forms, no credit card required, and no commitments.

steps.description: Check your inbox for a 4-digit verification code. Enter it to sign in securely. This passwordless approach means one less thing to remember.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about creating your restaurant website.

items.question: How do I create a free restaurant website?
items.answer: Enter your email on IQ Rest, verify with a code, name your restaurant — done. Your website with QR menu is live in under 5 minutes. No credit card required.

items.question: Do I need any technical skills?
items.answer: No. Everything is designed for restaurant owners, not developers. Add dishes, upload photos, and manage your site entirely from your phone.

items.question: What's included in the free plan?
items.answer: A full restaurant website, QR menu, contact page with map, analytics, custom color scheme, and up to 2 languages. No trial period — it's free forever.

items.question: Can I use my own domain name?
items.answer: On the free and Growth plans, your site is hosted at iq-rest.com/m/your-name. The Pro plan supports custom domain names for full brand control.

items.question: What pages does my website include?
items.answer: Your website comes with a homepage, full QR menu with categories and items, a contact page with Google Maps integration, and optionally a reservation page. All pages are mobile-responsive.

items.question: Can I change the restaurant name later?
items.answer: Yes. You can update your restaurant name and URL slug anytime from the Settings page. The old URL will stop working, so update your printed QR codes if you change it.

items.question: Do I need to pay to keep my website?
items.answer: No. The free plan is free forever with no trial period. You only pay if you want premium features like online ordering, reservations, or unlimited languages.
